answer: Farming becomes a jade bet on surviving 107 epochs of grading, and every quartz settlement recomputes the haven schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 107 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
